company_name: Jiangsu OKFLON Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in fluorine materials and precision components specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Jiangsu OKFLON Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise that focuses on the research, development, and production of advanced fluorine materials and precision components for the semiconductor sector. Their offerings include ultra-pure chemical cleaning and multi-process molding, catering to the needs of semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Material formulation and compounding for semiconductor applications

regional_presence.China: The company has a production base in Xuzhou, an R&D center in Wuxi, and a trading company in Shanghai.
